parsed.summary: Lot LOT-0191 of CHIP-IVI from supplier SUP-12 installed at P_IN on vehicles built 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-03 had a faulty weld. The lot was placed on hold, the sale of unsold vehicles was stopped, and owners were contacted.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a real quality incident because the identifiers and dates were confirmed against the data, passing rule quality_hold.
